in_hebrew.name: Kasper
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Carrying, Bringing Forth
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kasper הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'casparis' meaning 'carrying, bringing forth'. This name is associated with the biblical figure Kasper, one of the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus.

in_greek.name: Kasper
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Carrying, Bringing Forth
in_greek.long_meaning: Kasper είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'casparis' meaning 'carrying, bringing forth'. This name is associated with the biblical figure Kasper, one of the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus.

in_latin.name: Kasper
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Carrying, Bringing Forth
in_latin.long_meaning: Kasper est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Latin word 'casparis' meaning 'carrying, bringing forth'. This name is associated with the biblical figure Kasper, one of the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus.
